propositions: edit --review must parse as a valueless flag without consuming the next token and execute review_plan after the EDIT event is committed, mapping the verdict to exit codes 0/1/2/11 per ADR 0040 disposition mapping

claim --review must use shared _plan_review_gate_applies to sense gate applicability, call claim_gate_check and conditionally review_plan, claim the ticket only on PASS, and exit 1/2/11 on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable-degrade without invoking claim core

Both flags must import _disposition_exit_code lazily within their handler functions and propagate review_plan exceptions through the standard CLI error path without holding the store lock during review
claim --review must print a gate-disabled notice and proceed normally when the plan-review gate does not apply, and must never propagate the flag through the parent-first cascade
Help texts and exit-codes documentation must describe non-atomicity against concurrent store reconvergence and reference review-plan --status
